text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало is showered with praise as we
reflect on
the great efforts that brought
us here. She's
delighted that her talents
have been conveyed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Soon after, Кинг Хало encounters
Kawakami
Princess in the waiting room,
who excitedly states
her newfound
desire to win the Takamatsunomiya

Kinen as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Having come to this realization herself not long ago, Кинг Хало advises her to find what she really wants to do, and become first-rate at that.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And with that, Кинг Хало sets her sights
on the
Yasuda Kinen. With no intention
of stopping, she
looks ahead with a
fearless smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
